data.description: Optionally provide arbitrary binary data that is returned in subsequent QuoteQuery's Provided in order to allow the market maker to load from storage only once, instead of for each iteration of the query

price.description: The price of the offer Quoted in ask_denom, so eg for RUIJ @ $5, an offer of RUJI for ask of USDC, price = 5 an offer of USDC for ask of RUJI, price = 0.2

size.description: The size of the ask_denom that the market maker is willing to accept at the QuoteResponse::price

Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

Decimal.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)
